description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - The Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017 : Amend the Gaz.Ex.Nos. 2170/04 & 2182/32
reasoning: This gazette content contains amendments to regulations under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017. It specifically modifies existing regulations by extending time periods from "Six months" to "Twelve months" in previously published gazettes. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with regulatory frameworks, legal amendments, and statutory instruments.
